Body

Measurements are of the body, not the garment. Hover a column to see where it's measured. Your recommended size is highlighted.

Hover a column in the chart to see where it's measured.

How To Measure

Four Measurements,
Two Minutes

  1. Chest

    Measure around the fullest part of the chest, just under the armpits, keeping the tape level.

    01

  2. Waist

    Measure around your natural waistline — the narrowest point, just above the belly button.

    02

  3. Hips

    Stand with feet together and measure around the widest part of the hips and seat.

    03

  4. Height

    Stand barefoot against a wall, heels together, and measure from the floor to the top of the head.

    04
  • Measure over light clothing
  • Keep the tape snug, not tight
  • Between sizes? Size up for a relaxed fit
